# Manage activity groups, seasons, and programs

## Problem

Each activity currently has a single schedule, capacity, and participant list. Schools may need multiple groups for the same activity, with different schedules, instructors, or capacity, and need a way to organize offerings over time.

## Proposed outcome

Add staff-facing tools to create and manage groups under an activity, set group schedules and capacity, and organize offerings into seasons or programs.

## Acceptance criteria

- Staff can create, edit, and retire groups associated with an activity.
- Each group can have its own schedule, capacity, instructor, and participant roster.
- Students can identify which group they are joining.
- Staff can see group fill levels and any waitlist for each group.
- Season/program organization does not remove historical enrollment records.
- Access to management actions follows the permissions established by existing issue #5.
